programme.title: E14
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: E9 - Horses & Dogs
programme.desc: An Australian Outback Adventure. Tom Curtain is a professional horse trainer and Golden guitar winning singer/songwriter. He is also the founder of Katherine Outback Experience, a 90-minute horse and dog show that celebrates life in outback Australia. The show takes place at Tom’s ranch in Katherine, Northern Territory from April to the end of October, and in Pinjarra, a town in the south-west of Western Australia from November to March. It’s the end of March and it is time to go home. This will be a 4000km road trip through outback Australia. The resting points are not planned but Tom and Annabel have a large web of connections on stations and showgrounds that can be called upon at last minute for a place to rest the animals. Travelling with 6 horses and 12 dogs, these resting spots are a place for the animals to stretch tired legs have a drink and feed. It’s an adventure they look forward to but the extreme road and weather conditions comes with its own set of challenges.

programme.title: E10 - Camels
programme.desc: John runs Red Sun Camels in Broome, a tourist town in the north of Western Australia where visitors can experience a sunset camel ride along the famous Cable Beach. As his business expands, he needs seven more camels to add to the group, to enable his other camels to rest. But camels don’t come ready to be ridden by humans. Without extensive training they can be very dangerous, and the risk of them kicking a tourist could mean serious injury or even death. On the other side of Australia, 5000kms away, Peter has been commissioned by John to train and deliver seven wild camels. Known throughout Australia as the camel whisperer, Peter’s love of the animal is evident. Each of his seven beloved camels has a unique personality. It's a four-day transport. Due to Australia’s strict biosecurity laws, the camels have to pass a quarantine checkpoint at Kununurra, on the border of the Northern Territory and Western Australia. Clair is the government vet who will inspect each of the ani

programme.title: E11 - Turtles and Copperheads
programme.desc: A face-off with a giant turtle and a study of the deadly Copperhead snake's venom.

programme.title: I Love Hong Kong 2013
programme.desc: Hong Kong of the 1970s - a place bustling with opportunities and riches! The earnest Sung befriended the crafty Ha and the latter also helped Song found his first job: a waiter at a Teahouse. The boss of the Teahouse is a kind man, who has an array of quirky characters as his staff. The colorful characters attracted an interesting patronage, making it a happening place for the community. Fate has it that both Sung and Ha fell for the same girl: May who is from a well-to-do family. It's face off between the geek and the smooth-talker. While romance is blossoming between May and Song, May's best friend Yuen is a gutsy girl who insisted that bad boys are attractive and only have eyes for Ha. Decades past and Sung weathered many changing times: crash of stock market; era of mass-migration and more... programme.title: Memories
programme.desc: From the creative supervision of Katsuhiro OTOMO ('STEAMBOY', 'SHORT PEACE'), comes 'MEMORIES', a three-part work based on OTOMO's three original stories. ('MAGNETIC ROSE') Set in outer space at the end of the 21st century, the 1st part tells the story of two engineers who encounter the apparition of a female opera singer in an abandoned space freighter... ('STINK BOMB') The 2nd story is a satirical tale of a young lab technician who accidentally swallows experimental pills... ('CANNON FODDER') The 3rd part depicts war-time life in an imaginary world, using a characteristic camerawork.

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 講述結怨30年的兩個鄰居家庭，因下一代——放棄從醫追夢的服裝設計師「公主兒」，與歸國上任的集團理事「楊現斌」在職場重逢相戀，而被迫直面家族歷史傷痕。他們將在家族世仇與真摯愛情間抉擇，最終解開誤會、互相治癒，重生成為一個新家庭的溫暖故事。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 故事橫跨 1988 年至 2019 年，描述王牌刑警姜泰周（朴海秀 飾）為破案重返故鄉康盛，遇上負責此案的檢察官車時英（李熙俊 飾）。兩人因目標相同卻關係緊張，不得不放下敵意，共同展開追捕行動。
